gates.summary: policyengine 6.10.2, policyengine-uk 2.153.4 and policyengine-core 3.33.3 are installed and their requirements hold.
The pinned PyPI wheels match their RECORDs and the installed files (policyengine-uk: 3211 wheel members, 3211 installed files, policyengine-core: 199 wheel members, 199 installed files).
policyengine-core 3.33.3 satisfies policyengine-uk>=3.32.27; certification will record an exact qualified pair, since the publisher's claims do not cover both.
Read the release manifest and 7 artifacts with the configured credential; anonymous access returned HTTP 401.
enhanced_frs_2024_25 is the pinned 128,414,344 bytes with the UK single-year layout.
Supports 2024–2032, covering the required and horizon years.

72 model inputs are newly missing from the data (additional_residential_property_purchased, betting_exchange_commission, bingo_net_receipts, bus_in_london_trips, bus_pass_eligible, capital_gains_badr, capital_gains_residential_property, care_hours…)
Contract 2.1.0: every case, property and population check passed (905); 34 pending a methodology call; 120 unsupported by design.

model_only: checks the previous pair passed now fail: counted_once:working_tax_credit, counted_once:maternity_allowance, counted_once:widowed_parents_allowance; metrics disappeared: double_counts.corporate_sdlt 2025, double_counts.corporate_sdlt 2026, double_counts.corporate_sdlt 2027, double_counts.corporate_sdlt 2028, double_counts.corporate_sdlt 2029, double_counts.corporate_sdlt 2030, double_counts.corporate_sdlt 2031; data_only: checks the previous pair passed now fail: sign:vat
Raise additional rate by 3pp (additional_rate_plus_3pp): the tool's responsive check passes but 2030-31, 2031-32 are withheld (fewer than 10 records), so it cannot be recomputed there
